nodes.name: Normalize & Classify
nodes.notes: Handles both execution errors and trigger errors. Classifies error type and severity. Config lives at the top of this node.

nodes.name: Write Dead-Letter Audit Row
nodes.notes: Dead-letter row is ALWAYS written first. If the write fails the flow continues and the alert says the audit write failed.

nodes.name: Throttle & Decide
nodes.notes: De-duplicates ALERTS (not audit rows): same workflow+node+message alerts once per 15 min. Static data only persists on real executions, not manual test runs.

options.systemMessage: You are a senior n8n reliability engineer. Base every statement only on the error details provided. Never invent causes. If the evidence is thin, say so and set confidence to low. Be concise and actionable. Mark retry_safe true only when re-running cannot create duplicates or double side effects.

nodes.name: AI Triage
nodes.notes: Optional intelligence layer. If it fails the alert still goes out without triage.

parameters.inputSchema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"likely_cause": {"type": "string", "description": "Most probable root cause in one or two sentences"}, "first_fix": {"type": "string", "description": "The first concrete thing to check or change"}, "retry_safe": {"type": "boolean", "description": "True only if re-running the execution cannot cause duplicates or double side effects"}, "business_impact": {"type": "string", "description": "What this failure likely means for the business or customer"}, "confidence": {"type": "string", "enum": ["low", "medium", "high"]}}, "required": ["likely_cause", "first_fix", "retry_safe", "business_impact", "confidence"], "additionalProperties": false}

parameters.content:
## Global Error & Dead-Letter Handler (v2)
Set this as the **Error Workflow** of every production workflow (Settings > Error Workflow).

1. Normalize + classify (error class, severity, trigger vs execution errors)
2. ALWAYS write the dead-letter audit row first
3. De-duplicate alerts (15 min window) so an error storm cannot flood you
4. AI triage (optional, never blocks the alert)
5. Slack for every alert; email for critical/high

Edit alert email and severity rules at the top of 'Normalize & Classify'.
